gems.title: 奥德赛
gems.summary: 特洛伊战争结束后，伊萨卡国王奥德修斯踏上了返回家乡的艰险旅程。
gems.summaryEn: Odysseus, the legendary King of Ithaca, embarks on a long and perilous journey home following the Trojan War. Throughout his voyage, he is forced to confront the whims of gods, mythological monsters,
gems.whyWatch: 一部被低估的史诗回归，用现代视角重述古老神话，值得一看。
gems.whyWatchEn: An underappreciated epic that retells an ancient myth with a modern perspective, deserving more eyes.
gems.audience: 喜欢冒险、神话改编和宏大叙事的影迷
gems.audienceEn: Fans of adventure, mythological adaptations, and grand storytelling
